format: Krunker map JSON (v3.1.1 native, v7.1.4 fields)

properties.desc: bottom-centre position (y is the bottom face)
size; pooled maps store an index into the top-level xyz array as si
rotation in radians (x, y, z); omitted when zero
prefab id (omitted for CUBE); legacy maps use id
custom texture asset id (not available offline)
6 booleans Right Left Top Bottom Back Front, stored as hex
gate: 0 cost score, 1 require score, 2 require kills
v7 action list: up to 5 {ta, tc, tc2, tce, tct, tcc, tad, cd, cv0, cv1, cv2}
AI class (ci on non-AI objects is the colour palette index)

map_keys.desc: colour palette referenced by ci / ei
[x, y, z, team, dir, comp, teamOnly?, spread?]
v3 game config (camera / model / speed overrides)

actions.name: Teleport Destructible Interface to Path Node
